description: Create a track resource and issue a signed upload URL. stage is upload_url_issued — this does NOT upload audio bytes. The client must PUT bytes to track_upload.upload_url. Pass idempotency_key when retrying a create after a lost response. Prefer upload-session for many files. When collection_id is omitted, the organization default collection is used (API sentinel "default"). Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_create_track
